written: 2026-11-04, before any real Home Assistant recorder export was opened
what_it_is: A planning value for rung 11 (hand the den's four bulbs from den_lighting to the coordinator): can a 30% drop in corrections per occupied hour show within the hours one den gives? It is not a promotion gate and decides nothing about the coordinator.
applies_to: each mode stratum of a den-exposure-1 file on its own: no_game and game

inputs.occupied_h: hours den_lighting was in charge (its status shows automatic) with its own occupancy on, from its status sensor
inputs.people: actions from the HA app (a user id) or a switch or dimmer (no ids), one per human action, inside occupied_h
inputs.every_hold: every counted action that opened or replaced a hold, whoever made it (people, another automation, or a hold with no bulb row), inside occupied_h

hours_per_arm: hours_constant * phi / rate. A13: (1.96 + 0.84)^2 * (1 + 0.7) / 0.3^2 = 148 at phi = 1, for a two-sided test at alpha 0.05 with power 0.8 between a rate and 0.7 of it. A rate of 0 needs unbounded hours.

verdicts_in_order.plain: under 20 occupied hours in this stratum: too little to plan from

verdicts_in_order.when: hours_per_arm at the upper end of every_hold's interval > max_hours_per_arm
verdicts_in_order.plain: even counting every hold, at the high end of its rate, a 30% improvement would need more than 300 occupied hours per arm

verdicts_in_order.when: hours_per_arm at the lower end of people's interval <= max_hours_per_arm
verdicts_in_order.plain: people's overrides alone, at the low end of their rate, are frequent enough to show a 30% improvement within 300 occupied hours per arm
the answer depends on which holds count or on chance: export more evenings, or settle who made the uncounted holds

notes: phi stays 1 here. A dispersion fitted from a few 24-hour blocks is reported beside the verdict but never changes it; phi above 1 only raises the hours, so beyond_budget at phi = 1 holds a fortiori and within_budget is the optimistic case.
beyond_budget and within_budget cannot both hold: people's lower end is at most every_hold's upper end.
